notes: Open a new (unsaved) Корректировка остатка document; in its ТоварныеЗапасы register-records table add a row, fill Количество=1, then commit the row (finish editing) — all bootstrap. Action: copy the current committed row, which drives TestedFormTable.CopyRow (Таблица.СкопироватьСтроку, F9) via 'в таблице ... я копирую строку'. The document is never saved, so nothing persists (the capture pipeline kills the TestClient afterward). Same family/form as the accepted AddRow/DeleteRow/ChangeRow mappings. vanessa_client only.
